title: Structure-guided engineering of a polyphosphate kinase 2 class III from an Erysipelotrichaceae bacterium to produce base-modified purine nucleotides
content:
RSC Chem. Biol., 2025, 6,1328-1335
DOI: 10.1039/D5CB00108K, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution 3.0 Unported Licence.
Rachel M. Mitton-Fry, René Rasche, Ann-Marie Lawrence-Dörner, Jannik Eschenbach, Aileen Tekath, Andrea Rentmeister, Daniel Kümmel, Nicolas V. Cornelissen
The polyphosphate kinase 2 class III from an Erysipelotrichaceae bacterium is highly promiscuous. We determined the first crystal structure of the enzyme and applied structure-guided engineering to enable efficient access to ATP and GTP analogues.
